newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-BARCELONA'S PROSINECKI SIGNS FOR SEVILLA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BARCELONA'S PROSINECKI SIGNS FOR SEVILLA.

text.p: Robert Prosinekci will continue his odyssey through the Spanish league after Barcelona agreed to sell the troubled Croatian international to Sevilla.

Prosinecki won the European Cup with Red Star Belgrade before joining Real Madrid in 1991. But he failed to settle in the Spanish capital, and moved on to Oviedo on loan before joining Barcelona last season.
Prosinecki has struggled to find a regular first-team place at the Camp Nou with Johan Cruyff in charge and has hardly played under new coach Bobby Robson.

Sevilla coach Jose Antonio Camacho has been trying to buy Prosinecki since joining the club in the close-season. The southerners are now urgently in need of reinforcements after slipping to third from bottom in a season in which four clubs face automatic relegation.

The Sevilla board turned down Camacho's offer to resign last week. The club's problems have prompted unconfirmed reports that another new signing, World Cup striker Bebeto, is trying to leave Spain and return to Brazil.
